_note: SYNTHETIC golden set for the offline eval gate. Each item pairs a question with the expected answer facts and the source doc it should be answered from. These goldens are hand-written for the sample document in data/ and are NOT drawn from any real production traffic. Regenerate them whenever the sample document changes.

goldens.question: What is the overall accuracy reported for the dual-encoder retrieval model?
goldens.expected_output: The dual-encoder retrieval model reports an overall accuracy of 0.86 on the held-out set.

goldens.question: Which two embedding towers does the system use and what does each handle?
goldens.expected_output: It uses a text tower (a sentence embedding model) for text passages and a CLIP image tower for images, indexed separately.

goldens.question: What does the bar chart on the results page show?
goldens.expected_output: The bar chart compares retrieval accuracy across the text-only, image-only, and combined multimodal configurations, with the combined configuration highest.

goldens.question: What chunk size and overlap are used when splitting document text?
goldens.expected_output: Document text is split into chunks of 500 characters with an overlap of 100 characters.
